body.zh: 车上几十个控制器共用的一对线。这里讲的是 CAN 总线（ISO 11898-1）：任何时候线上只有一位，每个控制器都看得见，也都能说。
body.en: The pair of wires the dozens of controllers in a car share. The one here is the CAN bus (ISO 11898-1): at any moment there is one bit on the line, every controller sees it, and any of them can speak.

body.zh: 真实的总线上是两根线之间的电压差；游戏从"每一拍线上有一位"讲起，不讲电压、终端电阻和位定时。
body.en: On a real bus the bit is a voltage difference between two wires; the game starts from “one bit on the line each tick”, without voltages, terminating resistors or bit timing.

body.zh: 总线上的 0。只要有一个控制器说显性，整根线就是显性：它压过隐性。
body.en: A 0 on the bus. If any one controller says dominant, the whole line is dominant: it wins over recessive.

body.zh: 总线上的 1。只有所有控制器都说隐性（或者都不说话）时，线才是隐性。没人说话的总线一直是隐性。
body.en: A 1 on the bus. The line is recessive only when every controller says recessive (or none says anything). A bus nobody is talking on stays recessive.

body.zh: 探针每一拍把板从头跑一遍。寄存卡是板上唯一能跨过一拍的东西：这一拍存进去的值，下一拍读得出来。
body.en: The probe runs the board afresh each tick. A register is the one thing on it that lasts from one tick to the next: what is kept in it this tick can be read on the next.
